text: A marketing associate needs Claude to produce a quarterly campaign report that includes an executive summary, channel-by-channel performance analysis, and recommended next steps. text: A knowledge worker repeatedly asks Claude to generate a weekly status report, but the output consistently omits a key metrics section despite being included in prior successful runs. What is the most effective troubleshooting first step?
options: Assume Claude is permanently broken for reporting tasks and stop using the platform
Review the current prompt and any recently changed Project instructions or knowledge sources to identify what differs from the prior successful configuration
Keep submitting the exact same prompt repeatedly without changes until the metrics section reappears
Switch to an unrelated creative writing task to avoid diagnosing the missing section
correct_answer: Review the current prompt and any recently changed Project instructions or knowledge sources to identify what differs from the prior successful configuration
explanation: Diagnosing underperforming prompts or outputs (B) starts with systematically inspecting what changed—such as prompt wording, Project instructions, or uploaded knowledge files—and refining the instructions explicitly, rather than assuming permanent failure (A) or repeating the identical prompt without changes (C).
